marks.gloss_en: רבי יוסי לדבריו דרבי מאיר קאמר ליה -- the seifa's 'replacement' condition is R' Yosei arguing on R' Meir's terms, not his own limit (= p_hava_amina_yosei_lidvarav)

what you might have said: R' Yosei spoke to R' Meir according to R' Meir's words -- for me, even without a replacement in the priest's hand [exempt, lest shearing and labor]; for you, concede at least where the replacement is in the priest's hand, for they made one who does not acquire like one who acquires; and R' Meir said to him: no
ומי מצית אמרת הכי? והקתני סיפא: שהיה רבי יוסי אומר כל שחליפיו ביד כהן פטור מן המתנות, ורבי מאיר מחייב! -- the dispute is set over the replacement
והא דמיפלגי בחליפין -- להודיעך כחו דרבי יוסי, דפטר אפילו היכא דכהן בא עליו משני צדדין (= p_hava_amina_lehodiacha_kocho)

what you might have said: R' Meir obligates even an uncertain tithe, and their disputing over the replacement is to tell you R' Yosei's strength, who exempts even where the priest comes upon him from two sides
the seifa: R' Yosei would say, whatever has its replacement in the priest's hand is exempt from the gifts
Rav Pappa: all concede regarding an uncertain tithe that it is exempt from the gifts
what you might have said: R' Meir's reason is lest the law of the gifts be forgotten -- [so he obligates] even an uncertain tithe too
אמאי יחלוקו? ניחזי: אי שמן מית -- דכהן הוא, והאי דאיכא דבעל הבית; ואי כחוש מית -- דבעל הבית מית, והאי דאיכא דכהן הוא! (premised on R' Tarfon's earlier clause, the priest takes the better one)
חזר בו רבי טרפון (= p_ami_chazar_bo_r_tarfon)
if one of them died, R' Tarfon says: they divide
אקנויי קא מקני ליה בחצירו ... והוה ליה כשנים שהפקידו אצל רועה -- the transfer is why the courtyard case is like the shepherd's
הכל מודים in both cases; לא נחלקו אלא בחצר בעל הבית ורועה כהן (= p_roeh_maniach, p_baal_habayit_hamotzi, p_lo_nechleku_ela_bechatzar)
they disputed only in the homeowner's courtyard, with the shepherd a kohen
כיון דאית ליה פסידא לא מקני ליה מידעם, והוה ליה כאחד שהפקיד אצל בעל הבית -- having transferred nothing, the case is like the homeowner's
and R' Akiva holds: since he has a loss, he transfers nothing to him

אלא במאי פליגי? רבי עקיבא פליג בשנים שהפקידו אצל רועה, שמניח רועה ומסתלק? ורבי טרפון פליג באחד שהפקיד אצל בעל הבית? -- then about what do they dispute? would R' Akiva dispute the shepherd case, or R' Tarfon the homeowner case?
all concede, in two who deposited with a shepherd, that the shepherd places [it] between them and withdraws
R' Akiva says: the one who extracts from his fellow bears the burden of proof
and R' Akiva's parable -- to what is the matter like? to one who deposited with a homeowner, where the one who extracts from his fellow bears the burden of proof
רבי יוסי פוטר, שרבי יוסי אומר: כל שחליפיו ביד כהן פטור מן המתנות -- his general rule is his stated ground
and [the second] is obligated in the gifts
his two ewes that had not given birth bore two males -- both are the kohen's
and [the second] is obligated in the gifts
one had given birth and one had not, and they bore two males -- one is his and one the kohen's

it is necessary: had it taught us the first, [one would say] there R' Akiva said it because the two are from one; but his ewes that had not given birth, two from one and one from one -- say he concedes to R' Tarfon, that the one that bore one [offspring] is better

and had it taught us this one -- [one would say] here R' Akiva said it because both had not given birth; but one that had given birth and one that had not, and they bore two males -- say he concedes to R' Tarfon, that the [offspring] of the one that had not given birth is better. [So] it is necessary
